voice.summary: Sounds like a designer's bench notes: terse labels, helpful warnings and zero fluff. It explains contrast ratios and stops in numbers, and leaves taste to the user.
dos: Name controls by function, such as stops, angle and type
donts: Do not describe gradients with poetic filler
Do not hide the CSS output

taglines: See it on a real page first
Clean CSS from a clean bench
boilerplate: Hue Bench is a compact gradient generator that lets designers build multi-stop linear, radial and conic gradients, test text contrast on the result and copy clean CSS.

microcopy.error: Contrast too low. Try a darker stop.
microcopy.empty: No stops yet. Add one to start.

logo.note: A drop of colour is how every blend begins.
